model: one guard moves along one G-edge to an unoccupied attacked vertex; every retained successor remains in the same eternal family
theorem_hypothesis: gamma=alpha=gamma_infinity=3 with the literal greatest eternal family and the accepted C171 trapped rank-zero corridor setup
proved_candidate_statements: For an arbitrary eternal k-family and a nonempty ban, finite restricted deletion rank is at least Johnson distance to the ban minus one.
The independent pairs {q,w} and {r,y} have nonempty G-clique completion sets in the equality setting.
The first completion clique lies in the closed neighborhood of t and every noncolliding completion is retained by a unique t-move.
The explicitly retained state {v,r,y} uniquely exchanges v into every member of the second completion clique.
Every second-fan completion and every noncolliding first-fan completion either survives in the restricted kernel or has deletion rank at least one.
A minimum-rank second-fan state has no deletion-witness attack inside its completion clique; its exit hits r or y and every retained response is unbanned and lower-rank.
A wy nonedge gives a reciprocal two-state hinge, while overlap of the completion cliques forces wy and gives a reciprocal four-state square.

exact_control.scope: sharp gamma-two separated-fan boundary; not a gamma-theta counterexample

not_claimed: an elimination of the full rank-preserving escape cycle
